simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to קִיקָיוֹן (H7021) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: קִיקָיוֹן (qîyqâyôwn) means the gourd (as nauseous) First listed occurrence: Jonah 4 6.

definitions.full: H7021. qiqayon קִיקָיוֺן noun masculine Jonah 4:6 a plant (compare Assyrian Kukkânîtum ( כ ) a garden-plant, Dl HWB 327 ); — usually ricinus (R. communis , Linn. = castor-oil tree ; compare Dioscor iv. 164 κίκι (Egypt) = κρότων [ castor-oil tree ]; Talmud קִיק שֶׁמֶן see especially Löw p. 353 f. ); perhaps < bottle-gourd ( ᵐ5 κολόκυνθα ; i.e. cucurbita lagenaria , a vine growing and withering rapidly, Post in Hastings DB ii. 250 ); — 4:6 (twice in verse); 4:7 , 9 , 10 . קִיקָלוֺן see קלל .
